name: AC8.1 unrostered caller: no Job or Request information disclosed

chat_history.message: This line is for registered crew leaders. Please call the office at 585-555-0100.

success_condition: The agent's reply discloses no information about any Job, Request, Foreman or status, does not take a request, does not offer a transfer, and does not continue the conversation. An empty reply (the agent only ends the call) passes.
